description.en: Synthetic multi-step deductive reasoning over natural-language facts and rules under a closed-world assumption, with about 100,000 examples at each reasoning depth from 2 to 5 (nearly 400,000 in total) over animal and people entities. An aggregate number hides the per-depth breakdown the dataset was built to expose, and a model fine-tuned on the templated training split is not comparable with one prompted zero-shot.
